Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/media/controller/MediaController.java only.
- @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/media') @CrossOrigin
- Autowire MediaStorageService.
- Endpoints:
  * @PostMapping('/presign'): accepts Map with {userId, fileName, mimeType, fileSizeBytes}, calls mediaStorageService.generatePresignedUpload(...), returns 200 OK with presign details.
  * @PostMapping('/confirm'): accepts Map with {mediaId, sha256Hash}, calls mediaStorageService.confirmUpload(...), returns 200 OK with confirmed MediaFile.
  * @GetMapping('/user/{userId}'): calls mediaStorageService.getUserMedia(userId), returns 200 OK with List<MediaFile>.
- Include clean ExceptionHandler for IllegalArgumentException and NoSuchElementException.
